mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `groups` ( group_id, moim_account_id, user_id, invite_code, group_name, group_count, custom_rule, challenge_type, content, future_deposit_ratio_rule, duration_days, min_count, round_cycle_days, default_fail_pass_count, base_deposit_amount, group_status ) VALUES ( #{groupId}, #{moimAccountId}, #{userId}, #{inviteCode}, #{groupName}, #{groupCount}, #{customRule}, #{challengeType}, #{content}, #{futureDepositRatioRule}, #{durationDays}, #{minCount}, #{roundCycleDays}, #{defaultFailPassCount}, #{baseDepositAmount}, #{groupStatus} )
mapper.select: SELECT g.group_id AS groupId, g.moim_account_id AS moimAccountId, g.group_name AS groupName, g.group_count AS groupCount, g.challenge_type AS challengeType, g.group_status AS groupStatus, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM group_users member WHERE member.group_id = g.group_id AND member.group_user_status IN ('ACTIVE', 'PENDING_DEPOSIT') ) AS memberCount, CASE WHEN g.user_id = #{userId} THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS leader, ( SELECT me.group_user_status FROM group_users me WHERE me.group_id = g.group_id AND me.user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1 ) AS myMembershipStatus FROM `groups` g WHERE g.user_id = #{userId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM group_users gu WHERE gu.group_id = g.group_id AND gu.user_id = #{userId} AND gu.group_user_status IN ( 'ACTIVE', 'PENDING_DEPOSIT', 'PENDING_APPROVAL' ) ) ORDER BY g.created_at DESC

SELECT group_id, moim_account_id, user_id, invite_code, group_name, group_count, created_at, custom_rule, challenge_type, content, future_deposit_ratio_rule, duration_days, min_count, round_cycle_days, default_fail_pass_count, base_deposit_amount, group_status, updated_at FROM `groups` WHERE group_id = #{groupId}
mapper.update: UPDATE `groups` SET group_name = #{groupName}, custom_rule = #{customRule}, challenge_type = #{challengeType}, content = #{content}, future_deposit_ratio_rule = #{futureDepositRatioRule}, duration_days = #{durationDays}, min_count = #{minCount}, round_cycle_days = #{roundCycleDays}, default_fail_pass_count = #{defaultFailPassCount}, base_deposit_amount = #{baseDepositAmount}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE group_id = #{groupId}
UPDATE `groups` SET group_status = 'FINISHED', updated_at = NOW() WHERE group_id = #{groupId}
mapper.select: SELECT group_id, moim_account_id, user_id, invite_code, group_name, group_count, created_at, custom_rule, challenge_type, content, future_deposit_ratio_rule, duration_days, min_count, round_cycle_days, default_fail_pass_count, base_deposit_amount, group_status, updated_at FROM `groups` WHERE invite_code = #{inviteCode}
mapper.update: UPDATE `groups` SET challenge_type = #{challengeType}, content = #{content}, future_deposit_ratio_rule = #{futureDepositRatioRule}, duration_days = #{durationDays}, min_count = #{minCount}, round_cycle_days = #{roundCycleDays}, base_deposit_amount = #{baseDepositAmount}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE group_id = #{groupId}
